weather.reason: AI-funding scare (Meta) plus six-month-high oil and a 71% priced December hike; Nasdaq worst day since June, weak breadth.

take.what_happened: Meta beat earnings but went cash-flow negative and created sellable Class C stock to fund AI, setting off an AI-funding scare; oil hit six-month highs on Iran risk.
take.why_it_matters: Tech is priced on AI spending: if the richest buyer must sell stock to fund it, chip and AI-cloud suppliers reprice first. XLK slipped 0.1% and the Nasdaq 0.7% while energy and health care led.
take.what_to_watch: Wed 10/28 Fed press conference plus MSFT/GOOGL capex guidance, and Thu PCE inflation; hot PCE with $100+ oil firms up a December hike.

jargon.definition: Capital expenditures: money spent on long-lasting assets like data centers and chips.
jargon.why_it_matters: One company's capex is another's revenue; Meta's spending is Nvidia's sales and part of tech-sector gains.

jargon.definition: Cash left after running the business and paying for capex.
jargon.why_it_matters: Meta's went negative, which is why the stock fell despite beating.

jargon.definition: The giant cloud builders that rent out computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
jargon.why_it_matters: Their spending plans drive the tech sector; three report next week.

jargon.definition: Newer AI-only cloud renters like CoreWeave, often debt-funded.
jargon.why_it_matters: The most fragile link; they drop first.

jargon.definition: Insurance against a borrower not repaying; higher price means more worry.
jargon.why_it_matters: Meta's hit a record: AI fear has reached the bond market.

jargon.definition: New shares shrink each existing share's slice.
jargon.why_it_matters: Meta's Class C stock allows it.

jargon.definition: The date insiders may finally sell IPO shares.
jargon.why_it_matters: Brings sellers; why SPCX dropped Thursday.

jargon.definition: How many stocks rise versus fall.
jargon.why_it_matters: An index held up by a few giants is weaker than it looks.
